meta.title: In the last five minutes a vendor cannot raise its price on a single-line round
gaps: The existing bid price is not available as a token or read-back field, so the plan cannot guarantee that 101 is higher than the existing bid and 99 is lower.
The exact refusal text "You cannot increase the price" cannot be asserted with the available assertion operations.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 101 (open, price, submit).
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 99 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: In the last five minutes a vendor cannot raise its price on a single-line round

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
